What's really happening inside Claude Fable 5.1 and knowledge work?

The common story is that a better model writes better answers — but the real question is which effort setting earns the tokens you spend on it.

In this video, I share the inside scoop on running Fable 5.1 on low effort for real knowledge work:

- Why low effort finished a seven sheet workbook and 13 slide deck
- How extra effort surfaced questions that could flip the investment call
- What Sol still does better when another analyst checks your work
- Where a coded 37 second Blender film fits into knowledge work

Fable 5.1 makes a serious first draft cheap, and deciding whether that draft is right is still the part you own.
